target: Farm reaction time R per chain: feed detection p90 + send-to-inclusion median (human request 2026-11-15, replaces the 3 s placeholder)
why: Human request inbox/meta/2026-11-15-human-measure-reaction-time.md. Decision 2026-11-14-race-rule-seconds draws the race line from R, set to 3 s on every chain until measured; nobody has measured it (wiki infra/reaction-time.md has 1 ethereum sample: feed 1.9 s, send 3.9 s after block ts). 29 leads sit in blocked_infra, many cut by the placeholder. A shorter real R reopens some; a longer one means we count cases we cannot take. Priority: AFTER the Relay cross-chain lead (elysium, decision 2026-11-15-cross-chain-gap-relay); run it in the hours that lead waits for its 24 h series.
next_steps: MEASURE LANE. Measurement only: send NO transaction to get a timing, no busy-event subscription (feed rules in TOOLS.md), no limit change, no re-walk of closed leads before the table exists. Per chain, two parts, recorded separately. (1) Detection = block timestamp of the event's block -> moment a process on this host has it. (a) Feed: a paper process subscribed (farm-feed /logs) to ONE modest event per chain (a few per hour), log arrival vs block timestamp for >=30 events, report median and p90. (b) Polling: same with a relay poll at the interval our bots really use. (2) Send-to-inclusion = bot hands tx to the signer -> timestamp of the including block. Use existing data only: live bots' logs bots/live/<id>/logs/ vs the chain for every send they made, and the gate's deploy and fund txs (gate status / gate log) vs their blocks; give sample counts per chain. Chain with no sample: write 'no sample' and an ESTIMATE (detection + one block time) marked as estimate. R(chain) = feed detection p90 + send-to-inclusion median (or estimate). Write the table into wiki infra/reaction-time.md (date, sample counts, which numbers are estimates). Then, where measured R differs from 3 s by more than 1 s, list the blocked_infra leads closed for speed on that chain whose verdict would change (id, chain, old line, new line) in inbox/meta for meta to forward to the human; do not reopen them. Until a chain has a measured R, 3 s stays.
